ledger: 00:00–00:03: Initial kitchen has a microwave on the right counter and a range, hood, sink and window along the left side of a narrow passage. A closed white door with curtained glazing terminates the passage; nobody opens or crosses it.
00:00–00:03: The woman walks forward through the open kitchen/passage connection, then turns right beside a wall carrying two framed pictures.

00:03–00:05: A white-trimmed opening on the right connects this circulation area to a bedroom. Through it, a bed, bedside lamp, chandelier and curtained windows are visible. The woman crosses into that room.

00:05–00:06: The bedroom has a bed with pillows and a quilt, a bedside table and lamp, a rug, and two wooden dining-style chairs directly against the foot of the bed, facing inward toward the mattress.
00:05–00:07: Bedroom windows on adjacent walls show daylight, greenery and portions of outdoor structures. No exterior reverse view establishes a conflicting location or missing opening.

00:06–00:08: As the camera turns left within the bedroom, another doorway becomes visible beside a window and a small table holding a framed photograph. Through this doorway is a narrow space ending at a white glazed door.

00:08–00:09: The woman crosses that doorway into a kitchen area with a range and wall-mounted microwave on the left and a window on the right. Its relationship to the initial kitchen is not conclusively established; the visible route does not by itself prove an impossible connection.
00:00–00:09: No exterior-door traversal or reverse exterior view is shown. Audio is unassessed.

findings.entity: Two chairs at the foot of the bedroom bed
findings.invariant_violated: Furniture must functionally match the object it serves
findings.description: Two dining-style chairs sit side by side facing the bed, with their seats tucked against and partly beneath the quilted foot edge as though the bed were a dining table. The pillows, mattress and headboard establish that the central object is a bed; there is no table surface or usable knee space for this seating arrangement. Both chairs and their relationship to the bed are clearly visible at 00:05.50.
